content.comment_body: Hello, recently I attempted to read and write data to my [product_name] using the [product_name] app, and after some troubleshooting, I managed to get it working over WiFi and 4G. Now that I have my own place (where [product_name] is used for lighting controls), I wanted to set this up again so I could control my lighting remotely with the [product_name] app. However, when I try to access the control panel to grant access to the app, I receive this error: PROFILE CONFIGURATION NOT SUPPORTED. I’m able to download and upload programs, go online in [product_name] configuration software, and view live data, but I can’t seem to access this particular menu. Pinging my IP works fine. Can anyone point me in the right direction? Kind regards, a confused [product_name] user.
Welcome to the forum! The "Access Control" feature is available only for [product_name] base modules with [article_no] corresponding to newer versions.

Thanks for your reply. I thought I had previously been able to select this option, although I did help a friend who had a newer [product_name] module with internet access—maybe I’m mixing things up. The [product_name] app documentation suggests connecting this way without specifying a different setup for my version, though it does mention the web server is exclusive to newer hardware. If this isn’t the right way to connect through the app, could you suggest where I should adjust my settings?
I haven’t used the [product_name] app before. As far as I know, the version you’re using does not support access control or web server functionalities.

I found an old description from 2013 for the [product_name] app, which predates the latest hardware update. It confirms there were no access control or web server features mentioned back then. If you’re using the current app version, try selecting the older module type rather than the newer one.
Thank you, that’s helpful! Once I have everything set up, I’ll share my results here.

To enable remote access for your older module, you should modify the Ethernet connection settings since the access control panel isn’t available for this hardware (as noted above). I'll start a separate discussion detailing the steps I followed to get [product_name] working remotely via the app over WiFi/4G.

analysis.insight_summary: A user tries to set up remote access for their [product_name] module using the [product_name] app, but discovers access control and web server features aren’t supported on their hardware version. Documentation is unclear about the feature differences between versions, causing confusion. Community members clarify it’s a hardware limitation, not a software issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected to be able to configure access control and use remote management and web server functions with their [product_name] module, as described in the [product_name] app manual.
